name: dynasty-trade-calculator-frontend
//sideEffects: Every module here is side-effect free EXCEPT stylesheets, so the
bundler may drop unused re-exports from the barrels. Without this
field webpack must assume any barrel import might have side effects,
which is why components/ds/glyph-chevron-down.jsx exists: importing
Icon for one glyph pulled the whole PATHS map into /league.
NOT `false`. CSS imports ARE side effects by definition —
./draft.css purely for the import. A bare `false` invites the
bundler to drop them and ship an unstyled app.
//start: Production runs it via the systemd unit's `npm start`, and nginx is the
only legitimate client (upstream 127.0.0.1:3000); next start's default
0.0.0.0 left the raw Next port answering from the internet. Local dev
uses `npm run dev`. To serve a production build to the LAN, use

scripts.build: next build --webpack && node scripts/check-bundle-sizes.mjs && node scripts/check-public-bundle-privacy.mjs
